subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should deep code-safety test-file exclusion apply only to plugin scans, or also to installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans?
rationale: The patch changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader installed-skill scan boundary than the plugin-focused issue requires.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if maintainers intentionally accept that installed skills with test-named files/directories should be skipped in deep code-safety scans.

options.title: Pause for broader audit design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the canonical issue to settle string-literal masking or another rule-level fix before changing scan scope.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent security-audit hardening work makes this the best available history signal for the security-boundary choice.
